rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese equivalent for something belonging to it.

example.english: The camera got smashed, and even its lens cracked.
example.traditional: 呢部相機跌爛咗，連佢嘅鏡頭都裂埋。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 soeng1 gei1 dit3 laan6 zo2 lin4 keoi5 ge3 geng3 tau4 dou1 lit6 maai4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose standalone possessive for something belonging to it, as in 「呢個係佢嘅」.

example.english: That cat has left; this cage is its.
example.traditional: 嗰隻貓走咗，呢個籠係佢嘅。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 maau1 zau2 zo2 ni1 go3 lung4 hai6 keoi5 ge3
